instructions:
1. Set a decline bench under the Smith machine so the bar lines up with your lower chest.
2. Lie on the bench with your feet hooked under the pads. Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
3. Unrack the bar and lower it under control to your lower chest.
4. Press the bar straight up until your arms are fully extended.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your shoulder blades pulled back and down against the bench.
2. Lower the bar to the lower chest, not the upper chest.
3. Exhale as you press, inhale as you lower.
4. Keep your hips on the bench and feet anchored.

instructions:
1. Set a flat bench under the Smith machine so the bar lines up with your mid chest.
2. Lie on the bench with your feet flat on the floor. Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
3. Unrack the bar and lower it under control to your mid chest.
4. Press the bar straight up until your arms are fully extended.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your shoulder blades retracted and pinned to the bench.
2. Drive your feet into the floor for a stable base.
3. Exhale as you press, inhale as you lower.
4. Touch the chest lightly, do not bounce the bar.

instructions:
1. Set an incline bench at about 30 degrees under the Smith machine so the bar lines up with your upper chest.
2. Lie on the bench with your feet flat on the floor. Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
3. Unrack the bar and lower it under control to your upper chest.
4. Press the bar straight up until your arms are fully extended.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your shoulder blades retracted against the bench.
2. Lower the bar to the upper chest, just below the collarbone.
3. Exhale as you press, inhale as you lower.
4. Keep your back flat, do not arch off the bench.

instructions:
1. Place an upright bench under the Smith machine and set the bar to shoulder height.
2. Sit with your back against the pad and feet flat on the floor. Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
3. Unrack the bar and press it straight up until your arms are fully extended overhead.
4. Lower the bar under control back to shoulder height.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your back against the pad and core braced.
2. Drive the bar straight up, not forward.
3. Exhale as you press, inhale as you lower.
4. Lower until the bar reaches just above your shoulders.

instructions:
1. Set an incline bench to about 45 degrees and lie face down with your chest supported.
2. Grip a barbell with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart, and let your arms hang straight down.
3. Curl the bar up toward your shoulders by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms still.
4. Squeeze your biceps at the top.
5. Lower the bar under control until your arms are fully extended.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your upper arms vertical and stationary throughout.
2. Control the lowering phase, do not let the bar drop.
3. Squeeze the biceps hard at the top of each rep.
4. Keep your chest pinned to the pad to remove momentum.
